title: graph_node.v1
description: Motadata-aligned configuration-item vertex on map/ (flat wire = Vortex physical). Tenant lives on snapshot/Dest path, not on the node. CI-only types — alert/incident/metric/trace/change/ticket are never vertices. No nested metadata JSON bag. Physical Arrow overlay: graph_node_v1.physical.json (see MAP_PHYSICAL_OVERLAY.md).

entity_id.description: Canonical CI id within the Dest tenant. Same string as ingest ci_id / sketch entity_id after bind.

type.description: Motadata-style lowercase CI type (service, host, …). Non-CI Motadata names are rejected at admit.

last_seen.description: Unix epoch milliseconds UTC; refreshed on every upsert.

valid_from.description: Unix epoch milliseconds UTC; null = open start.

valid_to.description: Unix epoch milliseconds UTC; null = open end.
